Design a refined minimalist pottery workshop flyer, soft earthy colours: warm cream paper, muted terracotta, sandy beige, sage accents, dark brown highly legible typography. The ONLY wording must be these exact five lines, with no additional wording, logos, watermarks, labels, or signatures:
Pottery Workshop
Clay House Studio
24 July 2027
14:00–16:00
Beginners welcome
